messages:
maria: Heads up — spotted user query snippets showing up in telemetry payloads from the console search route. Potential PII (email fragments) in the `ui.search.snippet` field. Anyone else see this?
aj: whoa. repro steps? where exactly?
maria: Search for a user's email in the UI, look at `console-telemetry` events in honeycomb. The `snippet` field contains the first ~120 chars of the query. I think the unmasked query is being included before we apply redaction.

cheng: confirmed on my end. I pulled a sample trace: `event.family=console` + `route=/search` -> payload shows `ui.search.snippet: "john.doe@example.com has issues with..."`

ops-bot: incident-created: INC-2026-041 - Console telemetry exposing user-entered text (P0). Assigned to eng-platform oncall.
samir: P0? can we scope to honeycomb retention or sampling to remove existing exposures?
maria: immediate mitigation idea: stop sending `ui.search.snippet` for authenticated routes, switch to hashed or boolean presence flag. We can flip a feature flag in the router to drop the field.
emily: Agree. We should also rotate any derived indices that pulled snippet values into analytics (if any).
aj: quick patch: in console telemetry collector add `if (isAuthenticated(req) && route=="/search") payload.ui.search.snippet = null` — can do a hotfix and deploy to canary. PR incoming.

cheng: also want to audit other routes — quick grep shows `ui.*.snippet` emitted by quickpreview and insights cards too. Might be broader than just /search.
maria: good catch. We should add an allowlist: only emit snippets for public docs-preview routes. Everything else either hashed or redacted.
samir: agree. I'll open infra ticket to backfill and delete recent telemetry batches from the retention store where possible (privacy team requested that).
emily: action items: 1) aj hotfix feature-flag to drop snippets on auth routes (canary today) 2) cheng do a grep+list of routes that emit freeform user text 3) samir request immediate retention purge for last 24h samples 4) maria coordinate with privacy for disclosure.
aj: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4621 — small guard and flag. Deploying canary now.

ops-bot: deploy-started: canary/console/2026-04-21T14:12:03Z by aj
maria: thanks. also let's add a unit test to telemetry pipeline that blocks emitting fields that match email regex. small guard but helps.

cheng: will add tests + sweep through quickpreview/insights.
samir: privacy confirmed scope, asked for a one-off retention delete for last 48h and a follow-up review. I filed PRIV-34.
emily: moving this to rollup for postmortem: root cause seems to be an internal API change that added `snippet` to event schema without redaction rules documented. We need a checklist for adding freeform user text to telemetry.
maria: agreed. we'll follow up with a short RFC for telemetry ingest rules and a pre-merge check that flags new freeform text fields.
aj: can we add a quick console-side flag UI so support can toggle snippet emission off for a customer if needed?
maria: good idea for medium-term. for now hotfix + retention purge. I'll post status update to #incidents when purge completes.

ops-bot: deploy-complete: canary/console/2026-04-21T14:16:53Z - success
aj: canary looks clean; no more snippet field in recent events. rolling to stable after 15m watch.
maria: thanks everyone. follow-up owners: aj (hotfix + stable deploy), cheng (route audit + tests), samir (retention purge + privacy), emily (postmortem).
emily: noted. I'll draft postmortem and checklist template.
maria: closing thread when postmortem posted. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
